entities.summary:
Theism is an enduring and multifaceted belief system that has shaped human culture and history from ancient civilizations to modern times.

It is a concept that has been debated, discussed, and practiced in various forms throughout human history, with roots in ancient Mesopotamia, Egypt, Greece, and Rome.

Theism has played a significant role in the development of Western civilization, influencing art, literature, philosophy, and politics. It has also been a driving force behind the rise and fall of empires, the spread of religions, and the creation of cultural and artistic masterpieces.

Despite its global reach and diverse manifestations, theism has also been a source of conflict, persecution, and violence throughout history.

Today, theism continues to be an important aspect of many cultures and faith traditions around the world, shaping the beliefs, values, and practices of millions of people.
